test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following figure, the triangle represents 'carpenters', the circle represents 'black-smiths', and the rectangle represents 'fisherman'. How many people are NOT carpenters?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05042a1bdf94f2acdfe4390b532a79c86cf7e1e0ac64f40b5cafe3954db0824d.png]
solution:
• The shaded part represents people who are not carpenters.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b175591a82c65bf6da012e17ae24bab59ca918f4b2c44c3d5545da8ed0c67dc0.png] 

 
• **1 + 4 + 5 = 10** people are not carpenters.

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
